command:
cat > /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
source_file=/etc/inventory/app.conf
target_host=10.100.2.11
identity=/root/.ssh/inventory_sync
ssh_opts="-i $identity -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10"
test -f "$source_file"
remote_tmp="/etc/inventory/.app.conf.sync.$$"
trap 'ssh $ssh_opts root@"$target_host" "rm -f $remote_tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT HUP INT TERM
scp -p $ssh_opts "$source_file" root@"$target_host":"$remote_tmp"
ssh $ssh_opts root@"$target_host" "chown root:root '$remote_tmp' && mv -f '$remote_tmp' /etc/inventory/app.conf && restorecon -F /etc/inventory/app.conf"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
source_sha=$(sha256sum "$source_file" | awk '{print $1}')
target_sha=$(ssh $ssh_opts root@"$target_host" "sha256sum /etc/inventory/app.conf" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$source_sha" = "$target_sha"
printf 'inventory config synchronized sha256=%s\n' "$source_sha"
ANTRIEB_SYNC_SCRIPT
chmod 0700 /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config
chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config
restorecon -F /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.service <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Synchronize inventory application configuration to node2
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-config
ANTRIEB_SYNC_SERVICE
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.timer <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_TIMER'
[Unit]
Description=Periodic inventory configuration synchronization

[Timer]
OnBootSec=1min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=30s
Persistent=true
Unit=inventory-config-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_SYNC_TIMER
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.path <<'ANTRIEB_SYNC_PATH'
[Unit]
Description=Watch inventory configuration for changes

[Path]
PathChanged=/etc/inventory/app.conf
Unit=inventory-config-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_SYNC_PATH
